confound_caveat: Pre-cutoff quarters are also earlier quarters with a different volatility regime, so any pre/post accuracy gap is suggestive rather than a clean contamination test.
degenerate_split_caveat: The pre-cutoff group has n=2 - the self-reported cutoff (October 2023) predates all but 2 of the 268 phase2 events, since the project deliberately scores 2024-2026 earnings. The pre/post accuracy diff and its bootstrap CI/p-value above are NOT a meaningful statistical test (n=2 vs n=266) and should not be cited as evidence of anything - reported for completeness only, not as a finding. LLM self-reported training cutoffs are also known to be imprecise; this is the model's own stated answer, taken at face value per the spec's own methodology, not independently verified.
